title: The Oxford India Ghalib: Life, Letters, and Ghazals

verification.verification_notes: Internet Archive, WorldCat, and scholarly references verified the Russell/Islam edition and the documented conversational intimacy of Ghalib's Urdu letters ('murasale ko mukalima bana diya').

limitations: Nastaliq Urdu into English loses syntactic and idiomatic weight; the conversational register is difficult to reproduce and varies across editions and translations.
